cd /workspace/project && python3 -c '
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Check what exists in dist/modules
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls -la /root/opt/areloria/server/dist/modules/guild/")
print("=== Guild dist ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls -la /root/opt/areloria/server/dist/modules/npc/")
print("=== NPC dist ===")
print(stdout.read().decode()[:500])
client.close()
'
